changelog:
- Initial release of spraay-escrow skill.
- Enables safe agent-to-agent payments via Spraay x402 escrow: create, fund, monitor, release, or cancel on-chain escrows.
- Clearly separated create and fund steps; funds are only locked after funding.
- Explicit instructions, warnings, and best practices for user confirmation and safe handling of escrowed funds.
- Supports essential workflows for milestone payments, delivery verification, and secure transactions.
- Includes free endpoints for address safety checks, price lookup, and ENS resolution.
summary: Safe agent-to-agent commerce via Spraay x402 escrow. Create, fund, monitor, release, or cancel on-chain escrows — pay on verified delivery instead of paying blind. Full escrow lifecycle with confirmation guardrails. Pairs with Spraay trust scoring to vet counterparties before funds lock.
